question: Why is the named mudrā held extremely dear to Śrī Rāma and Sarasvatī?
premises: The mudrā is associated with Śrī Rāma.
The mudrā is associated with Sarasvatī.
It is regarded as extremely beloved by them.
inference: The mudrā’s special status derives from its cherished relation to both Śrī Rāma and Sarasvatī.
plain_english: This mudrā is considered extremely beloved of Śrī Rāma and Sarasvatī.
